reason: A client-side DSH web plugin that adds a selection toolbar for quoting conversation text into the current composer or a newly created conversation.

summaries.zh: 在 DSH 网页会话中选中文字后，通过浮动工具条将其引用到当前输入框或新会话中。
summaries.en: Adds a browser toolbar to quote selected text from a DSH conversation into the current composer or a new conversation.

capabilities: Reads user-selected conversation text in the browser
Inserts quoted text into the current composer
Creates a new conversation with quoted text prefilled
Adds a floating selection toolbar to the web interface
